sloka: अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगणोत्तम ।क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम् ।। ५.४०.४।।।।
transliteration: abhijñānaṁ ca rāmasya dadyā harigaṇottama ।kṣiptāmiṣīkāṁ kākasya kopādekākṣiśātanīm ।। 5.40.4।।।।

translations.english: "O best leader of vanaras remind Rama about the incident of the release of a blade of grass in anger blinding one of the eyes of the crow narrated to you.
